title: Show HN: Germany's new sovereign AI model Kolibri
summary: Germany's Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, a sovereign AI model designed to provide European independence from US-based AI providers and ensure data sovereignty for European organizations and governments.
problem_solved: Addresses Europe's dependency on foreign AI infrastructure and concerns about data sovereignty when using US-based AI services.
why_valuable: Provides European institutions with a domestically-controlled AI capability, ensuring sensitive data remains within European jurisdiction rather than being processed by American tech companies.
